gdpNominal.source: BEA, National Income and Product Accounts, Gross Domestic Product (third estimate)

realGdpGrowth.source: BEA, Real GDP percent change from preceding quarter (third estimate)

unemployment.source: BLS, Current Population Survey, unemployment rate (seasonally adjusted)

employmentPopRatio.source: BLS, Current Population Survey, employment-population ratio (seasonally adjusted)

cpiInflation.source: BLS, CPI-U all items, U.S. city average, not seasonally adjusted, 12-month change
cpiInflation.note: Computed from CPI-U index 334.980 (Aug 2026) vs 323.976 (Aug 2025) = 3.40%. September 2026 CPI not yet released as of 2026-10-09.

fedFundsUpper.source: Federal Reserve Board, FOMC federal funds target range upper limit
fedFundsUpper.note: Target range 3.75-4.00% after a 25 bp increase at the 2026-09-17 FOMC meeting (FRED DFEDTARU).

tenYearYield.source: U.S. Treasury / Federal Reserve H.15, 10-year Treasury constant maturity yield
tenYearYield.note: Daily value; latest published observation as of retrieval.

medianHouseholdIncome.source: Census Bureau, Income in the United States: 2025 (P60-289), CPS ASEC
medianHouseholdIncome.note: Released 2026-09-15. Up 2.6% in real terms from $85,210 (2024); margin of error +/- $1,040.

gini.source: Census Bureau, Income in the United States: 2025 (P60-289), Gini index of household income
gini.note: FRED series GINIALLRH. Change from 2024 (0.489) not statistically significant per Census.

lifeExpectancy.source: CDC/NCHS, Mortality in the United States, 2024 (Data Brief No. 548), final data
lifeExpectancy.note: Latest final data; no 2025 provisional life expectancy estimate found as of 2026-10-09.

population.source: Census Bureau, Vintage 2025 national and state population estimates (NST-EST2025)
population.note: Resident population 341,784,857 on July 1, 2025. BEA monthly series (FRED POPTHM) shows about 343.0 million for Aug 2026.

receipts.note: CBO estimate published 2026-10-08, reported as $5.4T, up $169B (3%) from FY2025. Value = Treasury FY2025 actual $5.236T + $0.169T. Final Treasury MTS for September 2026 not yet published.

outlays.note: CBO estimate published 2026-10-08, reported as $7.4T, up $386B (6%) from FY2025 ($7.011T actual).

deficit.note: CBO reports about $2.0T, $218B above FY2025 ($1.775T). Cross-check: Treasury MTS Oct-Aug deficit $1.966T + CBO-estimated September deficit $28B = $1.994T.

debtHeldByPublicPctGdp.source: CBO, The Budget and Economic Outlook: 2026 to 2036 (February 2026 baseline)
debtHeldByPublicPctGdp.note: CBO projection for end of FY2026 (99% at end of FY2025). Actual end-FY2026 figure not yet published. Treasury/FRED quarterly measure (FYGFGDQ188S) was 98.7% in 2026-Q1.

defense.source: Treasury MTS Table 9, function 050 National Defense
defense.note: Treasury Monthly Treasury Statement, fiscal-year-to-date Oct 2025 through Aug 2026 (11 months), net outlays. The final September 2026 MTS (full FY2026) is not yet published as of 2026-10-09 (due mid-October); CBO's Sept 2026 Monthly Budget Review gives only rounded category changes. CBO: full-year defense spending up about $48B (5%).

socialSecurity.source: Treasury MTS Table 9, function 650 Social Security
socialSecurity.note: Treasury Monthly Treasury Statement, fiscal-year-to-date Oct 2025 through Aug 2026 (11 months), net outlays. The final September 2026 MTS (full FY2026) is not yet published as of 2026-10-09 (due mid-October); CBO's Sept 2026 Monthly Budget Review gives only rounded category changes.

medicare.source: Treasury MTS Table 9, function 570 Medicare (net of offsetting premiums)
medicare.note: Treasury Monthly Treasury Statement, fiscal-year-to-date Oct 2025 through Aug 2026 (11 months), net outlays. The final September 2026 MTS (full FY2026) is not yet published as of 2026-10-09 (due mid-October); CBO's Sept 2026 Monthly Budget Review gives only rounded category changes.

medicaid.source: Treasury MTS Table 5, HHS Grants to States for Medicaid
medicaid.note: Treasury Monthly Treasury Statement, fiscal-year-to-date Oct 2025 through Aug 2026 (11 months), net outlays. The final September 2026 MTS (full FY2026) is not yet published as of 2026-10-09 (due mid-October); CBO's Sept 2026 Monthly Budget Review gives only rounded category changes. CBO: SS+Medicare+Medicaid combined up $217B (7%) for the full year.

nondefenseDiscretionary.note: Not published in MTS (budget-concept category). CBO February 2026 baseline dollar tables were not retrievable (cbo.gov blocks automated access). CRS R49408 cites CBO baseline FY2026 total discretionary outlays at 5.9% of GDP and nondefense discretionary budget authority at 2.7% of GDP. Fill from CBO when accessible.

netInterest.source: Treasury MTS Table 9, function 900 Net Interest
netInterest.note: Treasury Monthly Treasury Statement, fiscal-year-to-date Oct 2025 through Aug 2026 (11 months), net outlays. The final September 2026 MTS (full FY2026) is not yet published as of 2026-10-09 (due mid-October); CBO's Sept 2026 Monthly Budget Review gives only rounded category changes. CBO: full-year net interest up $115B (11%), widely reported as a record of about $1.1T.

topIncomeRate.source: IRC §1 individual income tax brackets (rates made permanent by P.L. 119-21, July 2025)
topIncomeRate.note: Top ordinary rate; applies above $640,600 single / $768,700 joint for 2026 per IRS inflation adjustments.

capitalGainsTopRate.source: IRC §1(h) long-term capital gains maximum rate
capitalGainsTopRate.note: Excludes the 3.8% Net Investment Income Tax (§1411); combined top federal rate 23.8%.

payrollRate.source: SSA, Social Security and Medicare tax rates (OASDI 12.4% + HI 2.9%, employer + employee)
payrollRate.note: Excludes 0.9% Additional Medicare Tax on wages above $200k/$250k.

socialSecurityWageBase.source: SSA, Contribution and benefit base for 2026

effectiveTariffRate.source: The Budget Lab at Yale, State of U.S. Tariffs (updated August 24, 2026)
effectiveTariffRate.note: Average statutory (pre-substitution) rate after Section 122 tariffs expired 2026-07-24 and were replaced by Section 301 tariffs; IEEPA tariffs struck down by the Supreme Court in Feb 2026. Budget Lab projects 11.8% by end-2026 under current law. A secondary citation gives 10.9% pre- / 9.0% post-substitution for the same date.

trustInGovernment.unit: % trust federal government just about always or most of the time
trustInGovernment.source: Pew Research Center, Public Trust in Government: 1958-2025
trustInGovernment.note: 2% just about always + 15% most of the time. Survey fielded Sept 2025; no newer Pew reading found as of 2026-10-09.

violentCrimeRate.source: FBI, Uniform Crime Reporting, 2025 Reported Crimes in the Nation

house.source: Office of the Clerk, U.S. House of Representatives, party breakdown (119th Congress)

supremeCourt.source: Supreme Court of the United States, current members; grouped by appointing president's party
supremeCourt.note: 6 appointed by Republican presidents, 3 by Democratic presidents. No vacancy or new confirmation in 2026 found.

states.asOf: Population: 2025-07-01 (Census Vintage 2025). Margins: 2024 general election certified results. Electoral votes: 2024-2028 apportionment (2020 Census).
sources: Census Bureau, Vintage 2025 state population estimates (NST-EST2025-ALLDATA): https://www2.census.gov/programs-surveys/popest/datasets/2020-2025/state/totals/NST-EST2025-ALLDATA.csv

State-certified 2024 presidential results as compiled in Wikipedia "2024 United States presidential election" results-by-state table (citing each state's certified canvass and FEC): https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/2024_United_States_presidential_election#Results_by_state ; margin computed as (R votes - D votes) / total votes x 100
FEC, Official 2024 Presidential General Election Results: https://www.fec.gov/resources/cms-content/documents/2024presgeresults.xlsx
Electoral votes: National Archives, Distribution of Electoral Votes 2024-2028: https://www.archives.gov/electoral-college/allocation
Maine and Nebraska margins are statewide (at-large) results.
